_comment: Meter presets. EVERY preset here is UNVERIFIED (verified: false): the url and the response paths are written from memory of each service's docs and have not been called with a key. The user verifies one with their own key before trusting it: set KEY locally, run curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" <url>, and compare the JSON with value_path / total_path / currency_path. Dotted paths: a number segment indexes a list. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

deepseek.note: UNVERIFIED. total_balance is believed to be a numeric string; the collector accepts numeric strings.

openrouter.note: UNVERIFIED. The fields are believed to sit under a top-level data object; if the real response has no data wrapper, use total_usage / total_credits as value_path / total_path.

new-api.note: NOTE ONLY, no collector in v1. Needs two calls on the relay's own host: GET <base>/v1/dashboard/billing/subscription (hard_limit_usd) and GET <base>/v1/dashboard/billing/usage (total_usage, often in cents). One meter makes one call, so this shows as unknown (preset has no collector).

one-api.note: NOTE ONLY, no collector in v1. Same two-call shape as new-api (billing/subscription plus billing/usage).
